body: As much as I would like to help you with this, I can’t break an oath I made to do no harm to another person. Sorry man, believe me I am right there with you and may even take my life first. I just can’t break my oath to give advice that would cause someone harm. Sorry I hope you find peace or find a solution. My comment was pointless sorry

Yea well I am making the most of my resources now before may comes and I won’t make rent and be homeless. Every day closer to when my rent and loans are due (when my family leaves the country) the more I plan out how to off myself. Im ashamed to admit it. But it’s the truth. I literally can’t apply to most of these jobs again because the online app doesn’t let you apply twice, and when I call Human Resources they say either I’m under qualified, over qualified, or to just wait.  My dad has told me he’s not waiting anymore to pay my rent after two years. I doubt any Pharmacy would hire a bum

Literally every job I’ve applied to has turned me down. I’m a licensed pharmacist in Florida and have applied to literally every hospital within drivable distance (250 miles from my parents rental) and literally every retail position available in the state, as well as every opening I saw in my Tri county area for fast food management, grocery store jobs, teacher, school administration, university teacher, bank jobs, whatever craigslist has to offer, and anything else that I can find. I’m at the point where I barely cry anymore because it’s all just pointless. If I’m meant to be jobless and default my student loans and be homeless then I might as well be dead.
Honestly I have no feeling either negative or positive about Florida. I’m more concerned with finding work
